name: aediv-mcp
description:
AEDI-V recommends products that match each moment of a video.

Provide Claude with a public video URL and select a region. AEDI-V analyzes the video and returns the moments where matches were found. Select a moment to see the matched products along with their image, title, and price. Select a product to open the product page.

Matching analyzes both on-screen objects and scene context. Recommendations include products visually similar to those objects, as well as others that fit the scene even if they do not appear on screen.

AEDI-V is built for discovery, not purchasing: there is no cart, checkout, or payment processing inside Claude. Purchases take place directly on the seller's site.

Works with public videos only. Matching runs within one region at a time. Prices are based on the time they were collected and may differ at purchase.

AEDI-V receives only the video URL you send and the region you select.

tool.name: get_video_products
tool.title: 영상 상품 검색, 분석 / Find products in a video
tool.description:
영상 속 상품을 찾고 매칭하고 추천하고 구매(buy)하려는 요청의 진입 도구. 예: "이 영상 상품 찾아줘/추천해줘", "find/recommend products in this video", "상품 지역을 미국으로 변경해줘". 영상 `url`이 필수다.
    호출하면 지역 선택 카드(위젯)를 띄운다. 지역이 명시되지 않으면 사용자가 카드에서 지역을 고르고, 분석과 진행, 결과 표시는 위젯이 처리한다. 지역 변경 요청에는 산문으로 답하거나 이전 카드로 안내하지 말고, 대화에서 쓰던 같은 `url`로 이 도구를 다시 호출한다(카드만 새로 띄울 뿐 중복 제출이 아니다).
    `confirm_region`, `poll_progress`, `restore_state`는 위젯 내부 전용이라 직접 호출하지 않는다. 호출 뒤에는 한 줄로 짧게 답하고, 지역을 단정하지 말고 결과가 위 위젯에 표시된다고 안내한다.

preselect.description: 선택적 지역 힌트. 사용자가 지역을 명시했을 때만 채운다. 지원 2개국 안이면 그 코드(`KR`, `US`), 도쿄나 파리처럼 그 밖 지명이면 `OTHER`. 지역 언급이 없으면 생략한다(사용자가 쓰는 언어나 채널로 추정하지 않는다). 최종 지역은 사용자가 카드에서 확정하므로 강제가 아니다.

_published_faq.name: How do I add aediv-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add aediv-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aediv-claude.aedi.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is aediv-mcp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aediv-mcp scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is aediv-mcp's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aediv-mcp scores 57/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the aediv-mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: aediv-mcp provides these MCP tools: confirm_region, get_video_products, poll_progress, and restore_state.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to aediv-mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to aediv-mcp in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
aediv-mcp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can aediv-mcp improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: confirm_region is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 50/100. 0 of 4 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
aediv-mcp is developed by AISUM Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
